info.name: Budds API
info.description: API collection for the Budds study companion application. Covers Nitro server routes and Convex auth HTTP routes.

exec: // Auth token is passed via cookies (session-based).
// The convex-token middleware on the server extracts the JWT from the session cookie.
// For Postman, you can set the session cookie manually after authenticating via browser,
// or use the /api/auth/convex/token endpoint to retrieve a token.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Better Auth routes proxied through Nitro to Convex HTTP actions.

request.description: Initiates Google OAuth sign-in. Returns a redirect URL to Google's consent screen. The callbackURL determines where the user lands after successful auth.
Returns the current session and user data. Requires a valid session cookie.
Exchanges the session cookie for a short-lived Convex JWT. Used by the client-side Convex auth plugin and the SSR convex-token middleware.
Ends the current session and clears the session cookie.
Permanently deletes the authenticated user's account and all associated data. Triggers the beforeDelete hook which calls accountDeletion.deleteCurrentUser.

item.name: RAG
item.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation endpoints for document-based Q&A.

request.description: Searches indexed documents and returns matching chunks with scores and metadata. Does not generate an AI completion.

item.name: Course
item.description: AI course generation (outline and section content).

request.description:
Generates a course outline from source documents or web content. Creates sections with titles, descriptions, knowledge types, and ordering. Persists results to Convex.

Response:
{
  "courseId": "string",
  "sectionCount": 5,
  "sections": [{ "title": "...", "knowledgeType": "factual|conceptual|procedural" }]
}

Rate limit: 3 requests per window.

Generates full section content: text explanation, quiz questions, flashcards, and optionally an audio primer. Runs all engines in parallel. Persists to Convex.

Response:
{
  "sectionId": "string",
  "status": "ready",
  "blockCount": 3,
  "failedEngines": []
}

Rate limit: 5 requests per window.

item.name: Flashcards
item.description: AI flashcard generation from indexed documents.

request.description:
Generates flashcards from folder documents. cardCount is clamped to 6-16. When taskId and roomId are provided, persists cards to the flashcard room via Convex.

Response:
{
  "title": "string",
  "model": "string",
  "cards": [{ "order": 0, "front": "...", "back": "...", "sourceDocumentId": "...", "sourceChunkContent": "...", "sourceFilename": "..." }],
  "cardCount": 12,
  "taskId": "string",
  "roomId": "string",
  "versionId": "string"
}

Rate limit: 5 requests per window.

item.name: Quiz
item.description: AI quiz generation and topic extraction.

request.description:
Generates a quiz from folder documents. questionCount clamped to 3-50. When taskId is provided, persists the quiz to Convex.

Response:
{
  "title": "string",
  "model": "string",
  "questions": [{ "order": 0, "question": "...", "type": "multiple-choice", "options": [...], "correctAnswer": "...", "explanation": "...", "sourceDocumentId": "...", "sourceChunkContent": "...", "sourceFilename": "..." }],
  "questionCount": 8,
  "taskId": "string",
  "quizId": "string"
}

Rate limit: 5 requests per window.

item.name: Audio Overview
item.description: AI-generated audio overviews (two-host dialogue) with TTS synthesis.

request.description:
Generates a two-host audio dialogue from document content. Writes an LLM script, synthesizes each turn via TTS (Aura or Dia engine), uploads audio blobs to Convex storage, and creates an audioOverview entity.

Response:
{
  "title": "string",
  "model": "string",
  "turnCount": 12,
  "totalDurationMs": 120000,
  "taskId": "string",
  "overviewId": "string"
}

Rate limit: 5 requests per window.

Injects a user question into an existing audio overview. Generates additional dialogue turns that answer the question, synthesizes audio, and persists as an interjection entity.

Response:
{
  "interjectionId": "string",
  "insertedAfterTurnIndex": 3,
  "answerTurnCount": 4,
  "turns": [{ "speaker": "host_a", "text": "...", "durationMs": 5000, "audioUrl": "..." }],
  "totalDurationMs": 20000,
  "model": "string"
}

Rate limit: 10 requests per window.

item.name: Calendar
item.description: Google Calendar integration for study session scheduling.

request.description: Initiates Google Calendar OAuth. Sets a CSRF state cookie and redirects to Google's consent screen requesting calendar.events and openid scopes.
Handles Google Calendar OAuth callback. Validates CSRF state, exchanges code for tokens, detects user timezone, stores encrypted tokens in Convex, and redirects to /app/learn?calendar_connected=true.

Disconnects Google Calendar. Deletes all synced Google Calendar events, then removes the Convex connection record.

Response:
{
  "disconnected": true,
  "googleEventsDeleted": 3,
  "googleEventsFailed": 0
}

Rate limit: 3 requests per window.

Syncs study sessions to Google Calendar. Creates calendar events for active courses that don't already have scheduled events. Uses user preferences for scheduling (preferred days, morning start, session length).

Response:
{
  "created": 2,
  "events": [{ "courseId": "...", "eventId": "...", "sessionType": "new_content" }]
}

Rate limit: 3 requests per window.
Returns the offline cache payload for a course section. Used for PWA offline support.

Exports all user data as a streaming ZIP file. Includes folders, documents (JSON + PDF files), conversations, messages, quizzes, flashcards, courses, and a manifest. Requires Convex auth token.

Response: application/zip stream with Content-Disposition header.

Tests R2 storage connectivity by attempting to fetch folder documents. Returns R2 config status and document keys.

Response:
{
  "configStatus": { "r2Endpoint": true, ... },
  "success": true,
  "count": 5,
  "docs": ["key1", "key2"]
}
